context: Measure theory: family of subsets closed under relative complements and countable unions

formulations.text: Let X be a set. A sigma-algebra on X is a family Σ⊆P(X) containing X, closed under taking complements X\A for A∈Σ, and closed under countable unions ⋃_{n≥1}A_n of members A_n∈Σ.

context: Measure theory: extended nonnegative countably additive set function on a sigma-algebra

formulations.text: Let Σ be a sigma-algebra of subsets of X. A nonnegative measure on (X,Σ) is a function μ:Σ→[0,+∞] with μ(∅)=0 and μ(⋃_{n≥1}E_n)=∑_{n≥1}μ(E_n) for every sequence (E_n) of pairwise disjoint sets in Σ.
